svg.title: BlockReduce phase by phase
svg.text: BlockReduce (as BlockSum) in a block of 128 threads: 4 warps of 32 lanes
value of thread t: its sum of squares of x[t], x[t+128], …, x = the embedding of " is"
WarpSum inside each warp: all 32 lanes get the warp's total
All 128 threads return 0.6516, the sum of the 128 values. Every warp repeats the second WarpSum,
so no thread has to send the total to the others.
each thread's lane and warp, and how many warps the block has
each warp combines its lanes; the first barrier waits until a previous call has read warp_results
after the second barrier, every warp combines the warp results (identity fills the unused lanes)
